name: p67_battery_image_dsc_init

ownership.argument: Writable module-owned 112-byte lv_draw_image_dsc_t scratch descriptor; never a firmware-owned descriptor.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer; initialized descriptor is passed synchronously to native image task submission.

side_effects: Initializes the caller-owned 112-byte native image draw descriptor

provenance.source: Exact .043 read-only native ABI audit and existing native background image descriptor ABI.

notes: 112-byte descriptor, source at +28, scale at +48/+52, pivot at +64/+68. Set source only to validated module-owned immutable ARGB8888 battery draw buffer. No public or hardware approval.
